ratings.comment: Tedward is awesome. He is an amazing lecturer and is always accessible outside the class. He is also a nice guy to interact with. Overall very good experience.

I liked 571 and am currently taking 572 with Dr. Erker again. He explains concepts clearly and I appreciate the way he adds questions of the day at the start of class to get people talking. It seems silly but as someone without many friends here, it has been really nice to be prompted to talk to classmates before class.

Have learned a lot about the theory and use of statistics with good case studies. There is a lot of time-intensive homework, but manageable. However, a better introduction to R/ R Markdown/ Latex formula writing might be useful at the beginning of the course. The exams are difficult but doable if you keep on studying for them.

Gives quizzes on textbook material before the lecture- so reading and understanding the textbook is necessary. Also very slow at teaching and speaking. Slightly unclear at times. Just not a great experience overall.
